parts.text: The aim of this experiment is to determine the internal volume of a test-tube using two displacement methods. Carry out the following instructions referring to Figs. 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3. You are supplied with a beaker of water. Fig. 1.1 Fig. 1.2 Fig. 1.3

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Pour approximately 80 cm 3 of water from the beaker into the measuring cylinder. Record the volume V 1 of water. V 1 = ......................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Lower the test-tube, closed end first, into the water in the measuring cylinder and push it down until it is filled with water, as shown in Fig. 1.2. Record the new water level V 2 . V 2 = ......................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate the volume V G of the glass of the test-tube using the equation V G = ( V 2 – V 1 ). V G = ...................................................... [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Remove the test-tube from the measuring cylinder and pour the water from the tube and the measuring cylinder into the beaker.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Pour approximately 70 cm 3 of water from the beaker into the measuring cylinder. Record the volume V 3 of water. V 3 = ......................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Gently put the test-tube, open end first, into the water in the measuring cylinder and carefully push it down with your finger or pencil until it is just covered with water, as shown in Fig. 1.3. Record the new water level V 4 . V 4 = ......................................................

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate the volume V A of air in the test-tube using the equation V A = ( V 4 – V 3 ) – V G . V A = ...................................................... [3]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Remove the test-tube from the measuring cylinder and pour the water from the measuring cylinder into the beaker. Fill the test-tube to the top with water from the beaker. Pour the water from the test-tube into the measuring cylinder. Record the volume V W of water from the tube. V W = ...................................................... [1]

4
